prompt: Audio-native text-to-video. By default model omni-flash-1.2 with a landscape 8-second clip at 720p will be used.

A 10-second clip. Omni 1.2 Flash makes 3 to 15 seconds (above 10 on paid plans) and is audio-native, so narration, dialogue and sound come from the prompt. To pin a specific voice, add referenceAudio_1 together with a referenceImage_* or character_*, as in the next prompt.
Reference-to-video (R2V): the uploaded image is a reference, narrated by 'Kore'. Up to 10 referenceImage_* on omni-flash-1.2.
Image-to-video with a start frame (startImage) and an end frame (endImage). The two frames are the only input — no referenceImage_*, character_* or referenceAudio_* alongside them.

Video-to-video edit (V2V): omni-flash-1.2 restyles the uploaded MP4. No duration here — output matches the trim window (max 10 s on a free plan, 15 s on a paid one). For all parameters see https://useapi.net/docs/api-google-flow-v1/post-google-flow-videos
